hardware.variant: Luckfox Lyra Zero W, RK3506B, 512 MiB DDR3 and factory SPI NAND

scenario: Place the combined loader at LBA 64 on a microSD with a FAT boot partition at LBA 32768. Omit a named uboot partition. Read back the card, insert it with power off, then apply power and capture UART0 at 1500000 baud, 8N1.
expected: The second-stage U-Boot prints its banner on UART0 after the OP-TEE handoff.
observed: Factory SPL selected MMC1 and read the FIT at sector 0x4000. All three payloads passed their SHA-256 checks. SPL loaded U-Boot at 0x00100000 and reported a jump to 0x00001000. OP-TEE reported its next entry at 0x03f011a7. Its switch to normal world was the last UART line.
limits: This observation covers the specified factory SPL and card FIT on one Zero W. The PCB revision is unknown.
The capture includes no second-stage U-Boot banner, EmberBSD kernel output or root mount.
